description: Helical-wheel geometry: apolar arc width and snorkelling-residue placement for the AP3D1 N-terminal helix versus inserting, ALPS and surface-binding benchmarks
code:
import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd, math
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
def useq(a):
    r=requests.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{a}.fasta",timeout=30); r.raise_for_status()
    return "".join(r.text.strip().split("\n")[1:])
S={k:useq(v) for k,v in {"AP3D1":"O14617","EPN1":"Q9Y6I3","ARFGAP1":"Q8N6T3","APOA1":"P02647",
                         "SAR1A":"Q9NR31","AMPH":"P49418","APL5":"Q08951"}.items()}
EIS=dict(A=.62,R=-2.53,N=-.78,D=-.90,C=.29,Q=-.85,E=-.74,G=.48,H=-.40,I=1.38,L=1.06,K=-1.50,
         M=.64,F=1.19,P=.12,S=-.18,T=-.05,W=.81,Y=.26,V=1.08)
APOLAR=set("AVLIMFWCY")   # residues counted as apolar for arc width
BASIC=set("KR"); ACID=set("DE")

def wheel(seq, angle=100.):
    n=len(seq); th=(np.arange(n)*angle)%360
    h=np.array([EIS[a] for a in seq]); t=np.deg2rad(th)
    phi=math.degrees(math.atan2((h*np.sin(t)).sum(),(h*np.cos(t)).sum()))%360
    rel=(th-phi+180)%360-180            # angle relative to the hydrophobic moment vector
    ap=rel[[i for i in range(n) if seq[i] in APOLAR]]
    arc=(ap.max()-ap.min()) if len(ap) else np.nan
    bas=rel[[i for i in range(n) if seq[i] in BASIC]]
    aci=rel[[i for i in range(n) if seq[i] in ACID]]
    return dict(seq=seq, n=n, mu_dir=round(phi,1), apolar_arc=round(float(arc),1),
                apolar_angles=np.round(np.sort(ap),0).tolist(),
                basic_angles=np.round(np.sort(bas),0).tolist(),
                acidic_angles=np.round(np.sort(aci),0).tolist(),
                mean_abs_basic=round(float(np.mean(np.abs(bas))),1) if len(bas) else np.nan,
                mean_abs_acidic=round(float(np.mean(np.abs(aci))),1) if len(aci) else np.nan)

panel={"AP3D1 1-14":S["AP3D1"][:14],"AP3D1 1-18":S["AP3D1"][:18],"AP3D1 1-24":S["AP3D1"][:24],
       "epsin1 H0 1-18":S["EPN1"][:18],"amphiphysin1 H0 1-27":S["AMPH"][:27],
       "ArfGAP1 ALPS1":S["ARFGAP1"][203:226],"Sar1A 1-23":S["SAR1A"][:23],
       "ApoA-I class A 220-241":S["APOA1"][219:241],"Apl5 yeast 1-24":S["APL5"][:24]}
rows=[]
for k,v in panel.items():
    d=wheel(v); d["name"]=k; rows.append(d)
df=pd.DataFrame(rows)[["name","seq","n","apolar_arc","mean_abs_basic","mean_abs_acidic",
                       "basic_angles","acidic_angles"]]
pd.set_option("display.width",230); pd.set_option("display.max_colwidth",40)
print(df.to_string(index=False))
print("""
apolar_arc  = angular width spanned by apolar residues (A,V,L,I,M,F,W,C,Y) on the wheel.
              Deeply inserting / lytic helices have wide arcs (>180 deg); class-A surface
              binders have narrow arcs (~100-140 deg).
mean_abs_basic/acidic = mean |angle| of Lys/Arg and Asp/Glu from the hydrophobic-moment
              direction. The class-A (surface-binding) signature is basic residues near the
              polar-apolar boundary (~90 deg, 'snorkelling') and acidic residues at the
              centre of the polar face (~180 deg).""")

# helical wheels
sel=["AP3D1 1-18","epsin1 H0 1-18","ArfGAP1 ALPS1","ApoA-I class A 220-241"]
fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,4,figsize=(19,5.2))
for ax,k in zip(axes,sel):
    sq=panel[k]; n=len(sq); th=np.deg2rad((np.arange(n)*100)%360)
    h=np.array([EIS[a] for a in sq])
    phi=math.atan2((h*np.sin(th)).sum(),(h*np.cos(th)).sum())
    for i,a in enumerate(sq):
        rad=1-0.035*i
        col="#2E86C1" if a in APOLAR else ("#C0392B" if a in BASIC else ("#1E8449" if a in ACID else "#95A5A6"))
        ax.scatter(rad*np.cos(th[i]),rad*np.sin(th[i]),s=330,c=col,edgecolor="k",zorder=3)
        ax.annotate(f"{a}{i+1}",(rad*np.cos(th[i]),rad*np.sin(th[i])),ha="center",va="center",
                    fontsize=7,color="white",zorder=4,weight="bold")
    mu=math.hypot((h*np.cos(th)).sum(),(h*np.sin(th)).sum())/n
    ax.arrow(0,0,1.25*np.cos(phi),1.25*np.sin(phi),width=.02,color="k",length_includes_head=True,zorder=2)
    ax.set_title(f"{k}\n$\\mu$H = {mu:.3f}, apolar arc = {wheel(sq)['apolar_arc']:.0f}$\\degree$",fontsize=10)
    ax.set_xlim(-1.6,1.6); ax.set_ylim(-1.6,1.6); ax.set_aspect("equal"); ax.axis("off")
fig.suptitle("Helical wheels (100 deg/residue). Blue apolar, red Lys/Arg, green Asp/Glu, grey other; arrow = hydrophobic moment",
             fontsize=11)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
